title: Student Worker
bio: Ezra Rottman (he/him) is a first-year from Yakima, Washington, planning to concentrate in Government and Economics with a secondary in Education Studies. He’s passionate about education and exploring how policy can create positive change. Outside of academics, he loves to jog, bike, explore new places, and play tennis, pickleball, and ping pong. At the Harvard Foundation, he’s excited to contribute to creating spaces that make all students feel supported. Area Harvard Foundation
